ui.welcome: Wolium tracks how long your apps are open and in focus. Data is stored only in the program folder on this computer.
ui.localApi: Enable local API (warning: reachable by other programs)
ui.localApiWarn: Any program on this computer will be able to read your current app activity. Enable only if you understand this.
ui.rpcFailed: RPC capture failed: Discord already owns the channel. Restart capture.
ui.rpcRestartHelp: Discord opens its RPC channel when it starts. Wolium can only intercept it if Wolium takes the channel first. The button closes Discord, lets Wolium take the channel, and starts Discord again so it connects through Wolium.
ui.discordRpcHint: Takes effect after Wolium starts before Discord; stores status texts locally
ui.helpWhat: Shows how much time you spent in the selected mode during the day. Use it to see when you were most active and with which apps.
ui.helpMouse: Mouse: hover the line to see details, click to pin the tooltip, scroll to zoom, hold left button and drag to move, middle click or double click to reset.
ui.helpTouch: Touch: tap anywhere to see details, pinch to zoom, drag with one finger to move, double tap to reset.
ui.pausedBanner: Analytics is paused. Nothing is being recorded.
ui.usageAccess: Usage access is required to read app activity.
ui.serviceDown: The collector service is not running.
ui.notifUpdateText: Version %s is ready. Install it now?
ui.backupHint: Android also backs up Wolium to your Google account automatically when system backup is on. A file backup is independent: save it to any folder or Google Drive and restore it after a reinstall.
ui.backupBad: This file is not a Wolium backup.
